{{Quote|Why is the help here so incompetent? One word from Daddy and I could get you fired!|Gana Lavin threatens Revan|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|woman]] [[Gana Lavin]]'s '''father''', whom the younger Lavin referred to as "'''Daddy'''," was a powerful man who lived during the [[Jedi Civil War]] between the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The man employed [[Gangster/Legends|thugs]] who were often used by Gana to intimidate others while she resided on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].

==Biography==
The father of the [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="KOTOR" /> [[Gender/Legends|female]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|247|Lavin, Gana}}</ref> [[Gana Lavin]] was an influential man who lived during the [[Jedi Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]].<ref name="KOTOR" /> Gana grew up in the luxury of the [[Upper City]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|city world]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] and many considered her spoiled. Protective of Gana, the man she regularly referred to as "Daddy" employed [[Gangster/Legends|thugs]] that she would often use to rough up those that angered her.<ref name="CSWE" /> Two of the thugs were [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]] who wielded [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblades]].<ref name="KOTOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic}}
In [[3956 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' places the events of ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', which include [[Revan/Legends|Revan's]] encounter with [[Gana Lavin]], in [[3956 BBY]].</ref> the former [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], who had [[Amnesia/Legends|lost]] his memories and believed himself to be a [[Republic soldier]], encountered Lavin in Taris' [[Upper City Cantina]]. She had ordered drinks for herself and a young [[Noble/Legends|noble]], but the drinks had not yet arrived. Frustrated and assuming Revan to be a [[Waiter/Legends|waiter]], she confronted him, insulting his [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] and threatening to use her [[Parent/Legends|father's]] influence to have him fired. Revan convinced her that he would bring out the drinks, and a moment later, an actual [[Unidentified Human waiter|waiter]] arrived with them, ending the conflict.<ref name="KOTOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|How dare you speak to me like that! Daddy's going to hear about this!|Gana Lavin to the player in potential dialogue|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
Gana Lavin's father was first mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', developed by [[BioWare]]. Dialogue involving the father are optional and have no impact on the plot, quests, or the player's alignment.<ref name="KOTOR" />

If the player, who takes the role of Revan, fails a persuasion check or selects other dialogue with Gana Lavin, she will run out of the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] claiming that she will tell her father about the situation. When the player leaves the cantina, they will encounter Lavin and two Rodian thugs brandishing [[Vibro-weapon/Legends|vibroblades]]. After the player defeats them, Lavin will run off and call for her father.<ref name="KOTOR" />
